svg.data-power-current-max: 2.5 A, as printed on the rear panel
svg.data-heat-dissipation: 187.55 BTU/hr at the 55 W maximum input (Table 27)
svg.data-acoustic-noise: 35.4 dB maximum LpA with 65 W AC AFO (Table 21)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 45 C (32 to 113 F); 40 C with a 10GBASE-T pluggable
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation up to 1524 m (5000 ft)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 EX4100 and EX4100-F switches; the four left cages are the Virtual Chassis ports. The uplink ports cannot be used as Virtual Chassis ports, and a 10GBASE-T transceiver cannot form a Virtual Chassis in a Virtual Chassis port
svg.data-uplink-ports: four front SFP+ ports taking 1G SFP and 10G SFP+ singly or mixed
